_meta.manual_update_path: Edit config/indicators.json, then run scripts/update_data.py or trigger the GitHub Actions workflow manually.
_meta.manual_update_path_zh: 编辑 config/indicators.json，然后运行 scripts/update_data.py，或在 GitHub Actions 中手动触发更新工作流。

ibkr_client_margin_loan_usd_bn.note: Interactive Brokers May 2026 ending client margin loan balances; single-broker proxy, not total market margin debt.

ibkr_margin_loan_yoy_pct.note: Year-over-year growth from IBKR May 2026 monthly brokerage metrics.

ibkr_margin_loan_mom_pct.note: Month-over-month growth from IBKR May 2026 monthly brokerage metrics.

hyperscaler_capex_qoq_growth.source: auto: SEC Companyfacts API; manual fallback
hyperscaler_capex_qoq_growth.note: QoQ growth in combined Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta cash CapEx / productive asset purchases. High growth keeps the AI capex cycle hot.

hyperscaler_capex_qoq_delta.source: auto: SEC Companyfacts API; manual fallback
hyperscaler_capex_qoq_delta.note: QoQ growth acceleration. Negative values are a death-signal candidate when upstream profits remain extreme.

bank_reserves_usd_tn.source: auto: FRED WRESBAL / Federal Reserve H.4.1; manual fallback
bank_reserves_usd_tn.note: Lower reserves imply higher liquidity drain risk. Watch 2.9T, 2.8T, and 2.5T zones.

tga_usd_bn.source: auto: FRED WTREGEN / Treasury General Account; manual fallback
tga_usd_bn.note: Treasury General Account balance. Higher TGA can drain private-sector liquidity.

sofr_rrp_spread_bp.source: auto: FRED SOFR minus RRPONTSYAWARD; manual fallback
sofr_rrp_spread_bp.note: Persistent positive spread and >3 bp stress are liquidity warning signs.

srf_usage_usd_bn.source: auto: New York Fed Markets API repo operations; manual fallback
srf_usage_usd_bn.note: Sudden SRF usage suggests funding stress.

zero_dte_stress_share.note: SPX 0DTE stress-day share. High readings imply short-dated option crowding.

call_premium_inversion.source: auto-proxy: Cboe Daily Market Statistics; manual fallback
call_premium_inversion.note: Free proxy uses index/equity call-share imbalance. 1 means calls are unusually expensive or crowded relative to puts in core AI/index names.

core_call_volume_heat.source: auto-proxy: Cboe Daily Market Statistics; manual fallback
core_call_volume_heat.note: SPX/SPXW call-volume heat proxy, normalized 0-1. Exact AI mega-cap option-chain heat still needs paid or unstable chain data.

hbm_supply_tightness.note: Normalized 0-1 estimate of HBM/advanced memory supply tightness.

take_or_pay_intensity.note: Normalized 0-1 estimate of take-or-pay / non-cancelable contract intensity.

customer_prepayment_intensity.note: Normalized 0-1 estimate of customer prepayment and commitment intensity.
